title: Interpretable Unsupervised Community Detection with LLM-Symbolized Structured Processes
description:
arXiv:2608.06402v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Community detection is a fundamental task in graph analytics that aims to identify cohesive groups of entities with similar behaviors or interests. Classic objective-driven methods struggle with complex graph structures, while deep-learning approaches improve performance at the expense of interpretability and rely on labeled data and training.
